description: 郵便局の窓口で、女性が荷物を発送するために職員へ小包を渡しており、近くでは男性が宛名ラベルを書き、別の客が封筒をポストに入れている場面。

stage1.passage: Using a post office is still important when people need to send letters, documents, or packages. Postal services can deliver items to different places, and customers often prepare addresses and pay postage before their mail is sent.

q1.text: What do customers often do before their mail is sent?
modelAnswers: They often prepare addresses and pay postage before their mail is sent.
Customers usually write the address and pay the postage before sending their mail.

questions.text: Have you ever sent a package or a letter? What did you send?
modelAnswers: Yes, I have. I sent a birthday present to my friend.
I once mailed a letter and a small gift to my grandparents.
No, I have never sent a package by myself, but I have gone to the post office with my family.

questions.text: Do you think people will still use post offices in the future? Why or why not?
modelAnswers: Yes, I think post offices will still be important because people need to send packages.
People may send fewer letters, but online shopping will probably increase package delivery.
I think post offices will remain useful because not everything can be sent through the internet.

sentences.text: There are several signs showing different postal services.

sentences.text: At the service counter, a woman is handing a parcel to a postal clerk so that it can be sent to its destination.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形・so that構文・助動詞can・受動態
sentences.ja: 受付窓口で、女性が目的地へ発送してもらうために小包を郵便局員へ手渡しています。

sentences.text: The clerk appears to be preparing to weigh the parcel and calculate the required postage.
sentences.grammar: appear to不定詞・prepare to不定詞
sentences.ja: 職員は小包の重さを量り、必要な郵送料を計算する準備をしているようです。

sentences.text: Meanwhile, a man is completing a shipping label that contains the recipient's address.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形・関係代名詞that
sentences.ja: 一方、男性は受取人の住所が記載された配送ラベルに記入しています。

sentences.text: Another customer is placing an envelope into a mailbox without speaking to a clerk.
sentences.grammar: 現在進行形・without＋動名詞
sentences.ja: 別の客は職員と話すことなく封筒を郵便ポストに入れています。

sentences.text: The woman may be sending the parcel to someone who is unable to receive it in person.
sentences.grammar: 助動詞may・現在進行形・関係代名詞who・be unable to
sentences.ja: 女性は直接受け取ることのできない誰かへ小包を送っているのかもしれません。

sentences.text: Several signs explain which services are available for domestic and international shipments.
sentences.grammar: 間接疑問文which・be available for
sentences.ja: いくつかの案内表示が、国内および海外への発送に利用できるサービスを説明しています。

sentences.text: The scene illustrates how traditional postal services continue to play an important role despite the growth of digital communication.
sentences.grammar: 間接疑問を含むhow節・despite＋名詞
sentences.ja: この場面は、デジタル通信が発達しているにもかかわらず、従来の郵便サービスが今も重要な役割を果たしていることを示しています。

sentences.text: As online shopping becomes more common, reliable delivery services are likely to become even more important.
sentences.grammar: Asを用いた変化・比較級・be likely to
sentences.ja: オンラインショッピングがより一般的になるにつれて、信頼できる配送サービスはさらに重要になる可能性があります。
